scope: Source-specific service follow-up for every eligible national chamber in the 16 current national-gap countries; 23 exact records. This is a documented partial pass, not completion of metadata/streams/EPG/rights validation.

method.sources: Official own institutions, institution-designated media pages and government rights notices; web retrieval/indexed content plus ordinary HTTP GET and selected Chromium/WebKit rendering.
method.distinctions: An indexed/source-text reading is not current endpoint access or decoded playback. An access error is not proof of no stream. House/Senate coverage is never inferred from another chamber.
method.browser_flow: Own institution designation -> dated source-player record -> normal muted native playback -> 1200-second later seek -> advancing decoded video; carried out only for the Belgian House recording.
method.browser_environment: Browser plugin not available; installed Playwright 1.64.0 Chromium and WebKit, 1440 x 1000.
method.safety: No outreach, CAPTCHA interaction, TLS bypass, authentication workaround, hidden/private API access, media downloads or YouTube manifest extraction. Only public page URLs and compact findings saved; no raw HTML or session tokens.
method.permissions: Per-use rights conclusions are scoped to published terms/workflows. Content visibility or download controls do not imply blanket embedding, re-streaming, direct-player or programme-data permission.

strong_followups: Belgian House dated archive decoded in Chromium and WebKit; source offers embed/share/download workflows.
Bulgaria institution-owned portal content CC BY 4.0 and explicitly documented public agenda/archive/calendar REST API.
Iceland expressly permits channel distribution and offers dated-player embed/download workflows, but direct browser access remains held.
Latvia publishes conditional official-platform embed permission.
Singapore restricts live re-streaming; Malta and Trinidad and Tobago have limited-use terms.
Trinidad TV default retrieved schedule is dated July, and SA house programme PDFs carry different update dates.
